text:
maya: Quick question — can route cards show per-model telemetry + quota side-by-side? Right now people are confused when a route spikes but model usage is low.
alex: Agree. My thinking: top-level route summary, then a collapsible "models" list. Minimal row height by default.
saul: Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/route-model-cards — see the compact variant.
maya: @alex would this change saved-query scope? saved queries are currently route-scoped.
alex: We shouldn't change default saved-query semantics. Instead add a `model focus` toggle in the save modal, options: `route | route+model | model`.
saul: Also quota concerns — some teams want per-model budget tracking. Do we surface quota usage per-model on the card?
maya: Only if there's an assigned quota or the user has billing perms. Otherwise hide the badge to avoid noise.
alex: Backend idea: expose metrics.models[] in route payload: id, name, qps, quota_pct. Example API:
```
GET /api/routes/r-123?expand=models_telemetry
Response:
{
  "id":"r-123",
  "models":[{"id":"m-1","name":"redwood-13b","qps":12,"quota_pct":0.42}, {"id":"m-2","name":"redwood-7b","qps":5,"quota_pct":0.11}]
}
```
maya: Nice. We'll gate behind a feature flag `route_model_telemetry_v1` for canary rollout.
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled Thu 10:00 PST :rocket:
saul: :thumbsup: Need a quick interactive prototype for product testing by EOW.
alex: I'll build a small mock (CodeSandbox / Figma tweaks) and share link here when ready.
maya: Next steps: Alex mock, Saul finalize save-modal copy, eng to draft API contract. I'll open the tracking issue and link specs.
saul: sounds good.
alex: ack, will start today.
